color.$description:
The semantic colour layer for the dark theme.

This file defines exactly the same token names as themes/light.json — the build fails if the two ever diverge. Note the two structural inversions the dark theme makes: elevation reads as *lighter* surfaces rather than shadow, and interaction states step *up* the ramp (hover is lighter) instead of down.

canvas.$description: The page behind everything. Never put text directly on it without a surface.

surface.$description: Default raised content surface: cards, panels, sheets.

surfaceRaised.$description: A surface above another surface. Shadow barely reads on a dark canvas, so elevation is carried by lightness instead.

surfaceSunken.$description: A contextual 3% recessed fill inside a dark surface: code blocks, inset lists, and track backgrounds.

backgroundMaterialUltraThin.$description: Lowest-tint translucent material. Pair with blur.backgroundMaterial.ultraThin.

backgroundMaterialThin.$description: Translucent tint for compact chrome and lightly separated background material. Pair with blur.backgroundMaterial.thin.

backgroundMaterialRegular.$description: Default translucent tint for panels and floating controls. Pair with blur.backgroundMaterial.regular.

backgroundMaterialThick.$description: High-opacity tint for sheets and content-bearing overlays. Pair with blur.backgroundMaterial.thick.

backgroundMaterialUltraThick.$description: Highest-tint translucent material. Pair with blur.backgroundMaterial.ultraThick.

backgroundMaterialHighlight.$description: Renderer-isolated highlight for translucent material edge lift.

backgroundMaterialShadow.$description: Thirteen-percent elevation shadow for floating material backgrounds.

labelSource.$description: White foreground source from which adaptive opaque label tiers are composed.

text.$description: Primary body and heading text, expressed as white at the primary semantic label strength.

textMuted.$description: Secondary text: captions, help text, metadata. The translucent source lets the containing surface participate in the result.

textDisabled.$description: Tertiary-strength text for disabled controls. Deliberately low contrast.

border.$description: Default component boundary, derived from the same opacity-based fill system as separators.

borderStrong.$description: Emphasised component boundary: hovered controls and active field borders.

focusRing.$description: Keyboard focus indicator. Lighter than the light theme's so it separates from the canvas.

shadow.$description: Elevation shadow colour. Much stronger than the light theme's: a soft shadow is invisible against a dark canvas, which is why the dark theme also steps surfaces lighter.

overlay.$description: Translucent backdrop behind dialogs, drawers, menus, and other elevated surfaces.

action.$description: The accent tone. Lighter than in the light theme so it carries dark foreground text.

actionWash.$description: Lowest-emphasis action-tinted surface for provenance and preview scaffolding.

onAction.$description: Dark foreground: the dark theme's action colour is a light fill.

neutral.$description: Idle neutral control fill, composed as 5% white over its actual dark surface.

positive.$description: The positive tone. Success, confirmation, safe-to-proceed.

warning.$description: The warning tone. Needs attention but is not an error.

critical.$description: The critical tone. Errors and destructive actions.

opacity.$description: Adaptive semantic label strengths for the dark theme. Renderers combine these values with color.labelSource instead of treating every tier as an unrelated grey.
